This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It had purple skin. It was present in a [[Unidentified space-freighter's hangout|space-freighter's hangout]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] at which time [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was engaged in a bar-brawl. Following this, the local schoolboy Berd Lin burst in, recruiting many of patrons in an effort to rescue his mother from Imperial forces arresting her on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Harix]].

==Behind the scenes==
This individual appeared in the background of [[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures 7|''Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures'' 7]], which republished ''[[Bring Me the Children]]'', originally a newspaper comic strips by [[Russ Manning]] that had been published by [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] in [[1980]]. The Revwien in this scene was not actually present in the original newspaper strip, but was added to the panel to make it better fit a comic book rather than newspaper format.
